topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 61 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 12 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 7 functional families. Its contracts share 31 common project-authored base contract(s) (twostageownable, basefee, packageversioned). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
